info.title: ProbeHive API
info.description: Contract-compatible API for ProbeHive organization bootstrap, local authentication, Monitors, immutable revisions, Runs, Observations, evaluated health, and Incidents.

head.summary: Report process liveness without a body
Report PostgreSQL readiness without a body

get.summary: Return this OpenAPI document in Development
Report whether the first administrator exists

post.summary: Create the first administrator and provision the installation Organization
post.description: Creates the first administrator, provisions the installation Organization with slug 'default' and its default Project through the idempotent provisioning use case, then issues a session cookie. A new installation is usable without a separate Organization step.

201.description: The first administrator and the installation Organization were created and a session cookie was issued.

get.summary: Issue or rotate a synchronizer antiforgery token

200.description: The request token and required header name. A host-only antiforgery cookie is also set.

post.summary: Authenticate a local user and issue a session

200.description: The authenticated user. A fresh session cookie is also set.

204.description: The session was invalidated and its cookie expired.

get.summary: List Organizations with their default Projects
get.description: Requires any authenticated session. Returns the caller's Organization memberships in creation order with the Organization id as a tie-breaker, and a bare empty array when none exist.

200.description: The Organizations visible to the caller.

post.summary: Idempotently provision an Organization and default Project
post.description: Requires the instance Administrator role. The creator becomes the new Organization's Administrator member in the same transaction. A matching slug and display name replays with 200 and writes no membership; a new Organization returns 201.

201.description: The Organization and default Project were created.

put.description: Requires the organization.write permission. The slug is immutable because it is the idempotency key for provisioning; after a rename, provisioning the same slug with the pre-rename display name conflicts and the current name replays.

get.summary: Return an Organization and its default Project

get.description: Requires statusPage.write, which built-in roles grant only to Organization administrators. Returns no content before a draft exists. There is no anonymous route in this milestone slice.

put.description: Requires statusPage.write and antiforgery. The request explicitly selects one through fifty non-archived Monitors in this Organization, supplies operator-chosen labels, and defines deterministic array order. Version zero creates the first draft; later updates require the current positive version.

get.description: Requires integration.manage. Returns Administrator-only destination configuration and never returns signing secrets or encrypted-secret metadata.

200.description: The Organization's Webhook Integrations in creation order.

post.summary: Create a disabled signed Webhook Integration
post.description: Requires integration.manage and antiforgery. Generates an active signing secret, returns it exactly once, and stores only AES-256-GCM ciphertext. The Integration remains disabled because delivery is not implemented by this slice.

201.description: The disabled Integration and its one-time signing secret.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents storage of the one-time signing secret response.

put.summary: Enable or disable a signed Webhook Integration
put.description: Requires integration.manage and antiforgery. Uses the current Integration version for optimistic concurrency. At most five Integrations may be enabled in one Organization. Newly projected Alerts receive a stable route for every Integration enabled at projection time; no network call or Delivery Attempt is created.

200.description: The Integration in the requested state. Repeating its current state with the current version does not advance the version.

post.summary: Prepare a new Webhook signing secret
post.description: Requires integration.manage and antiforgery. Starts a two-phase rotation, keeps the current secret active, and returns the pending secret exactly once. No second rotation may begin until the pending secret is activated and the former secret is retired.

201.description: The advanced Integration and its one-time pending signing secret.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents storage of the one-time signing secret response.

post.summary: Activate the prepared Webhook signing secret
post.description: Requires integration.manage and antiforgery. Makes the single pending secret active for future calls and leaves the former active secret retiring.

200.description: The Integration with its new active secret version.

post.summary: Retire the former Webhook signing secret
post.description: Requires integration.manage and antiforgery. Removes ciphertext for the single retiring secret while retaining bounded version and timestamp audit metadata.

200.description: The Integration after the former secret is retired.

put.summary: Apply a valid Monitor state transition
Change how often a Monitor is due
put.description: Requires an Administrator session. Changing the interval appends no revision: a revision snapshots check configuration, and scheduling frequency is not check configuration.

get.summary: List immutable revisions in ascending number order

post.summary: Validate and append the next immutable revision

get.summary: List current and upcoming maintenance windows
get.description: Requires maintenance.read. Returns start-ordered windows whose half-open interval has not ended, including cancelled windows until their original end so cancellation remains inspectable.

200.description: Current, upcoming, and cancelled-but-not-ended maintenance windows.

post.summary: Create one bounded Monitor maintenance window
post.description: Requires maintenance.write and antiforgery. Starts and ends are explicit UTC instants defining [startsAt, endsAt); startsAt cannot be in the past, duration is at most 30 days, and non-cancelled windows cannot overlap.

get.summary: Return one fully scoped maintenance window
get.description: Requires maintenance.read. A real window under the wrong Organization, Project, or Monitor returns 404.

post.summary: Cancel a current or upcoming maintenance window
post.description: Requires maintenance.write and antiforgery. Cancellation is idempotent and retains the original half-open interval as durable evidence; an ended window cannot be cancelled.

get.description: Requires monitor.read. Health is a versioned policy conclusion over Run evidence and remains distinct from any single Run outcome.

get.summary: List immutable Alert intents for one Monitor
get.description: Requires alert.read. Returns Incident-derived Alert intents, not a claim that any notification was attempted or delivered. Results are newest-first by occurredAt and Alert id.

get.summary: List routed deliveries, maintenance suppression, and attempts for one Alert
get.description: Requires alert.read. Every lookup carries Organization, Project, Monitor, and Alert scope. A maintenance-suppressed route identifies its retained window and has no network attempt. The audit omits destination URLs, secrets, signatures, response bodies, arbitrary headers, and provider text.

200.description: The Alert's routed deliveries and attempts.

get.description: Requires incident.read. Returns a bounded newest-first keyset page ordered by createdAt and Incident id. nextCursor is null on the final page and otherwise must be sent back unchanged.

get.summary: Return one fully scoped Incident and its timeline
get.description: Requires incident.read. A real Incident identifier under the wrong Organization, Project, or Monitor returns 404.

post.description: Requires incident.write. Acknowledgement records the current actor and an immutable timeline entry without changing health. Repeating acknowledgement is idempotent; a resolved Incident returns 409.

get.description: Requires monitor.read. Returns a bounded newest-first keyset page ordered by scheduledFor and Run id. notBefore is required so PostgreSQL can prune retained monthly partitions. nextCursor is null on the final page and otherwise must be sent back unchanged with the same filters.

post.summary: Execute a Monitor's latest revision now
post.description: Requires monitor.write and antiforgery. The request synchronously executes the latest revision through this process's embedded worker and returns the completed manual Run. Draft and paused Monitors may be exercised explicitly. A Monitor without a revision returns 409, exhausted shared execution capacity returns 429 without queueing, and an API-only process returns 503.

get.description: Requires monitor.read. The lease holder is never exposed. A real Run identifier under the wrong Organization, Project, or Monitor returns 404.
Requires monitor.read. In-flight and skipped Runs have no Observation and return 404. The response contains only the bounded codes, timings, and protocol details persisted for a completed HTTP check.

sessionCookie.name: probehive.session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server-side session token. Only its SHA-256 hash is persisted.

antiforgeryCookie.name: probehive.antiforgery
antiforgeryCookie.description: Host-only selector cookie issued by the antiforgery endpoint.

antiforgeryHeader.name: X-ProbeHive-Antiforgery
antiforgeryHeader.description: Synchronizer request token returned by the antiforgery endpoint.

RunNotBefore.name: notBefore
RunNotBefore.description: Inclusive lower scheduledFor bound. Exactly one RFC 3339 timestamp is required.

RunCursor.name: cursor
RunCursor.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the preceding page.

RunOutcome.name: outcome
RunOutcome.description: Optional exact outcome filter. In-flight Runs have no outcome and are included only when this filter is absent.

RunLocation.name: location
RunLocation.description: Optional exact Probe Location identifier, bounded to 63 UTF-8 bytes.

IncidentCursor.name: cursor
IncidentCursor.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the preceding Incident page.

AlertCursor.name: cursor
AlertCursor.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the preceding Alert page.

Location.description: Canonical relative URI of the created resource.

MaintenanceWindow.description: The fully scoped one-time Monitor maintenance window.

MonitorHealth.description: The Monitor's current evaluated health and bounded evidence summary.

Incident.description: The fully scoped Incident and its immutable timeline.

BadRequest.description: Malformed input, validation failure, or invalid antiforgery state.

Forbidden.description: The principal lacks the required role or the browser origin was rejected.

Run.description: The fully scoped Run without its lease-holder token.

NotFound.description: The route or fully scoped resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The requested operation conflicts with current or concurrently updated state.

TooManyRequests.description: The applicable immediate capacity or request-rate limit was exhausted.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The process is not configured to perform this operation.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The route does not allow this method.

ValidationError.description: One field-level failure. 'code' is the stable contract identifier clients localize from; 'message' is current English documentation and may be reworded without a compatibility event.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. Prose is always English; clients localize from 'code' and from the 'code' of each validation error.

code.description: Stable identifier for a non-validation problem. Absent on validation problems, where each entry of 'errors' carries its own code.

MaintenanceWindowResponse.description: One durable Monitor maintenance interval. The status is evaluated by the server clock; interval bounds are half-open [startsAt, endsAt).

StatusPageDraftResponse.description: Private Organization-owned configuration only. It includes no Monitor target, internal evidence, publication token, or anonymous URL.

StatusComponentResponse.description: A public label and deterministic position associated with one Monitor. This identity is distinct from Monitor identity.

MonitorHealthResponse.description: Current evaluated Monitor health. Counts always expose the full Phase 1 quorum denominator instead of a bare percentage.

AlertDeliveryResponse.description: One stable routed delivery. It deliberately omits destination URL and secret material.

suppressionReason.description: Stable reason no external call will be made; null for an unsuppressed route.

maintenanceWindowId.description: The event-time maintenance window when suppressionReason is maintenance; otherwise null.

DeliveryAttemptResponse.description: Append-only evidence of one bounded external call. Provider bodies, arbitrary headers, and provider text are never retained.

failureCode.description: A stable allowlisted ProbeHive failure code; never provider text.

RunResponse.description: A Run without its secret lease-holder token. Nullable state fields distinguish in-flight, completed, and skipped Runs.

ConfirmationCauseResponse.description: Explicit causal identity for a confirmation Run. Present only when kind is confirmation.

ObservationResponse.description: Bounded persisted execution detail. It contains no target-supplied headers, body, message, or lease-holder token.

CreateFirstAdministratorRequest.description: Request property names are matched ASCII-case-insensitively; canonical spellings are shown.

LoginRequest.description: Request property names are matched ASCII-case-insensitively; canonical spellings are shown.

destinationUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS URL without user information, a query string, or a fragment; the server enforces a 2,048-byte limit.

enabled.description: Whether future Alert projections create a stable Webhook route for this Integration.

signingSecret.description: Returned exactly once. The complete encoded value is the future HMAC key.
Returned exactly once for the pending secret version.

WebhookIntegrationStateRequest.description: Request property names are matched ASCII-case-insensitively; canonical spellings are shown. Version is the current Integration version and provides optimistic concurrency.

ChangeMonitorIntervalRequest.description: Request property names are matched ASCII-case-insensitively; canonical spellings are shown.

CreateMonitorRevisionRequest.description: Request property names are matched ASCII-case-insensitively; canonical spellings are shown.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL without user information or a fragment; length is measured in UTF-16 code units.

headers.description: Header names must be unique using ASCII case-insensitive comparison.

name.description: HTTP token excluding Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, Host, Content-Length, and Transfer-Encoding using ASCII case-insensitive comparison.

value.description: Value without Unicode control characters; length is measured in UTF-16 code units.
